```{r Setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ====================================================================
# SETUP AND DATA PREP
# ====================================================================
packages <- c("igraph", "lsa", "dplyr", "Matrix", "ggplot2", "tidyr")
new_packages <- packages[!(packages %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"])]
if (length(new_packages)) install.packages(new_packages)
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

NEA <- read.csv("cleanData.csv")
target_vars <- c("pl_radj", "pl_bmassj", "pl_orbper", "pl_orbeccen", "pl_insol", "pl_dens")
NEA <- NEA[complete.cases(NEA[, target_vars]), ]

calc_flags <- c(
  "<a refstr=CALCULATED_VALUE href=/docs/composite_calc.html target=_blank>Calculated Value</a>",
  "<a refstr=CALCULATED_VALUE href=/docs/pscp_calc.html target=_blank>Calculated Value</a>"
)
NEA <- NEA[!(NEA$pl_radj_reflink %in% calc_flags), ]
NEA <- NEA[!(NEA$pl_bmassj_reflink %in% calc_flags), ]

# ====================================================================
# MONTE CARLO SIMULATION INITIALIZATION
# ====================================================================
num_runs <- 100
threshold_value <- 0.97
log_vars <- c("pl_orbper", "pl_bmassj", "pl_radj", "pl_insol", "pl_dens")

# Dataframes to track Sub-Community counts per Main Cluster across runs
sub_counts_df <- data.frame(
  Run_ID = 1:num_runs,
  Cluster_1_SubCounts = numeric(num_runs),
  Cluster_2_SubCounts = numeric(num_runs),
  Cluster_3_SubCounts = numeric(num_runs)
)

mc_results_list <- list()
print(paste("Starting", num_runs, "Monte Carlo iterations with Sub-Clustering..."))

# ====================================================================
# MONTE CARLO LOOP
# ====================================================================
for (i in 1:num_runs) {
  
  NEA_sim <- NEA # Using 100% of data to test pure algorithmic stability
  
  # 2. Prepare and Log-Transform
  selected_columns_logged <- NEA_sim[, target_vars]
  valid_log_vars <- intersect(log_vars, colnames(selected_columns_logged))
  for (v in valid_log_vars) {
    selected_columns_logged[[v]] <- log10(selected_columns_logged[[v]])
  }
  
  # 3. Min-Max Scaling
  normalized_columns <- apply(selected_columns_logged, 2, function(x) {
    (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  TRMOE_NEA <- t(normalized_columns)
  colnames(TRMOE_NEA) <- NEA_sim$pl_name
  
  # 4. Cosine Similarity & Thresholding
  cosine_matrix <- lsa::cosine(as.matrix(TRMOE_NEA))
  cosine_matrix[cosine_matrix < threshold_value] <- 0
  diag(cosine_matrix) <- 0
  
  # 5. Build Network & Clean Isolates
  cosine_sparse <- Matrix::Matrix(cosine_matrix, sparse = TRUE)
  cosine_net <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(cosine_sparse, mode = "undirected", weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE)
  isolated <- which(degree(cosine_net) == 0)
  cosine_net_clean <- delete_vertices(cosine_net, isolated)
  undirected_net <- simplify(cosine_net_clean)
  
  # 6. Run MAIN Louvain
  Louvain_Comm <- cluster_louvain(undirected_net)
  temp_assignments <- data.frame(pl_name = V(undirected_net)$name, Main_Cluster = Louvain_Comm$membership)
  temp_merged <- merge(NEA_sim, temp_assignments, by = "pl_name")
  
  # 7. Identify TRUE Main Clusters dynamically to prevent label switching
  main_profiles <- temp_merged %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Main_Cluster) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(Med_Radius = median(pl_radj, na.rm=TRUE), Med_Eccen = median(pl_orbeccen, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(True_Main = dplyr::case_when(
      Med_Radius < 0.5 ~ "1",
      Med_Eccen > 0.2 ~ "3",
      Med_Radius > 1.0 & Med_Eccen < 0.1 ~ "2",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ))
  
  main_to_true_dict <- setNames(main_profiles$True_Main, main_profiles$Main_Cluster)
  
  # 8. Run SUB Louvain
  sub_assignments_list <- list()
  c1_subs <- 0; c2_subs <- 0; c3_subs <- 0
  
  # Set up continuous counters for clean naming (1.1, 1.2, etc.)
  sub_counters <- list("1" = 1, "2" = 1, "3" = 1)
  
  for (mc in unique(temp_assignments$Main_Cluster)) {
    true_m <- main_to_true_dict[as.character(mc)]
    nodes_in_mc <- which(Louvain_Comm$membership == mc)
    
    if (length(nodes_in_mc) > 2) {
      subgraph <- induced_subgraph(undirected_net, nodes_in_mc)
      sub_louvain <- cluster_louvain(subgraph)
      num_subs <- length(sub_louvain)
      
      # Track overall community counts for the line graph
      if (true_m == "1") c1_subs <- c1_subs + num_subs
      if (true_m == "2") c2_subs <- c2_subs + num_subs
      if (true_m == "3") c3_subs <- c3_subs + num_subs
      
      # Generate clean names and increment the counter
      if (true_m %in% c("1", "2", "3")) {
         start_idx <- sub_counters[[true_m]]
         clean_names <- paste0(true_m, ".", start_idx:(start_idx + num_subs - 1))
         sub_counters[[true_m]] <- sub_counters[[true_m]] + num_subs
      } else {
         clean_names <- paste0("Other.", 1:num_subs)
      }
      
      # Assign the clean names to the planets
      sub_assignments_list[[as.character(mc)]] <- data.frame(
        pl_name = V(subgraph)$name,
        True_Main = true_m,
        Sub_Cluster_Raw = clean_names[sub_louvain$membership]
      )
    }
  }
  
  # Log sub-community counts for this run
  sub_counts_df$Cluster_1_SubCounts[i] <- c1_subs
  sub_counts_df$Cluster_2_SubCounts[i] <- c2_subs
  sub_counts_df$Cluster_3_SubCounts[i] <- c3_subs
  
  # 9. Merge Back & Summarize Medians for Sub-Clusters
  all_sub_assignments <- dplyr::bind_rows(sub_assignments_list)
  NEA_clustered <- merge(NEA_sim, all_sub_assignments, by = "pl_name")
  
  run_summary <- NEA_clustered %>%
    dplyr::filter(True_Main != "Other") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(True_Main, Sub_Cluster_Raw) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(
      Run_ID = i,
      Count = dplyr::n(),
      Med_Mass = median(pl_bmassj, na.rm = TRUE),
      Med_Radius = median(pl_radj, na.rm = TRUE),
      Med_Period = median(pl_orbper, na.rm = TRUE),
      Med_Eccen = median(pl_orbeccen, na.rm = TRUE),
      Med_Insol = median(pl_insol, na.rm = TRUE),
      Med_Dens = median(pl_dens, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      Mean_Mass = mean(pl_bmassj, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Radius = mean(pl_radj, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Period = mean(pl_orbper, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Eccen = mean(pl_orbeccen, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Insol = mean(pl_insol, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Dens = mean(pl_dens, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  mc_results_list[[i]] <- run_summary
  
  if (i %% 10 == 0) print(paste("Completed run", i, "of", num_runs))
}

# Combine and Export
MC_Master_Data <- dplyr::bind_rows(mc_results_list) %>%
  dplyr::select(Run_ID, True_Main, Sub_Cluster_Raw, dplyr::everything())

print("==================================================")
print("          MONTE CARLO SIMULATION COMPLETE         ")
print("==================================================")
write.csv(MC_Master_Data, "MC_SubCluster_Results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
MC_Master_Data <- read.csv("MC_SubCluster_Results.csv")
```

# Number of Communities versus Run ID
```{r Graph 1}
# Number of Sub-Communities per Run ID (Faceted 3x1)
ggplot(sub_counts_long, aes(x = Run_ID, y = Sub_Count, color = Main_Cluster)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.75, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  
  # Split into 3 stacked plots sharing the same X-axis
  facet_wrap(~ Main_Cluster, ncol = 1) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Cluster 1 (Small)" = "#991A1E", 
    "Cluster 2 (Hot Jups)" = "#1D528A", 
    "Cluster 3 (Eccentric)" = "#C98E2E"
  )) +
  
  # Lock Y-axis to clean integer ticks (2, 3, 4)
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(2, 3, 4), limits = c(1.8, 4.2)) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", # Legend is redundant now because panel headers label the clusters
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray20", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray80", fill = NA)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Sub-Communities per Parent Cluster",
    x = "Run ID",
    y = "Number of Sub-Communities"
  )
```

# Master Sub-Cluster Summary Table
```{r SubCluster Summary}
# Filter summary to only include runs matching the modal sub-cluster count
subcluster_summary_table <- MC_Master_Data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(True_Main, Run_ID) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    (True_Main == 1 & dplyr::n_distinct(Sub_Cluster_Raw) == 3) |
    (True_Main == 2 & dplyr::n_distinct(Sub_Cluster_Raw) == 3) |
    (True_Main == 3 & dplyr::n_distinct(Sub_Cluster_Raw) == 3)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(True_Main, Sub_Cluster_Raw) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    Avg_Count      = round(mean(Count, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    Avg_Med_Mass   = round(mean(Med_Mass, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    Avg_Med_Radius = round(mean(Med_Radius, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    Avg_Med_Period = round(mean(Med_Period, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Avg_Med_Eccen  = round(mean(Med_Eccen, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    Avg_Med_Insol  = round(mean(Med_Insol, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Avg_Med_Dens   = round(mean(Med_Dens, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(subcluster_summary_table)
```

### Boxplot
```{r}
# 1. Filter for k=3 topology & reshape data into long format
all_params_long <- MC_Master_Data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(True_Main, Run_ID) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(Sub_Cluster_Raw) == 3) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Mean_Mass, Mean_Radius, Mean_Period, Mean_Eccen, Mean_Insol, Mean_Dens),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Clean up labels and fix facet ordering
    Feature = factor(Feature, 
      levels = c("Mean_Mass", "Mean_Radius", "Mean_Period", "Mean_Eccen", "Mean_Insol", "Mean_Dens"),
      labels = c("Mass (M_Jup)", "Radius (R_Jup)", "Period (days)", 
                 "Eccentricity", "Insolation", "Density (g/cm³)")
    )
  )

# 2. Multi-panel boxplot grid
ggplot(all_params_long, aes(x = factor(Sub_Cluster_Raw), y = Value, fill = factor(True_Main))) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.3, outlier.size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ Feature, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Sub-Cluster Stability Across All Physical Parameters",
    x = "Sub-Cluster ID",
    y = "Parameter Value",
    fill = "Main Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
